description: What field rules (properties.rules) decide for a set of answers: 'answersAfter' lists answers as the server stores them after the replay (null: none stored; the question id the server adds to an answer is left out), 'states' the states the rules give the questions (question id, or group/question/item inside a repeating group, to locked, required, title, description: only what a rule decided, 'required' being the last active rule's own value; a locked question is never required). 'hiddenFields' are the form's declared hidden-field names, 'hiddenValues' what the link gave, 'today' the respondent's date. Run by backend tests/app/services/test_field_rules_cases.py and webapp src/lib/field-rules.cases.test.ts; field rule cases that also check validation are in answer-validation.cases.json (checks 'fieldRules').

cases.name: title and description: the last active rule wins for each property
title and description: a rule that is not active changes nothing
title and description: a later rule sets only the property it names
required: an active rule that says false is recorded, so is one that says true
required: rules that are not active record nothing
read-only without a value: the question is locked and the given value is removed
read-only: while the rule is not active the given value stays
read-only and required: the question is locked and the required flag is only recorded
read-only on a multiple choice that allows several answers does nothing
read-only on a question type that cannot be locked does nothing
set value: the last active rule that sets a value wins
set value: a later read-only rule does not remove an earlier set value
set value: a rule that is not active leaves the given answer
set value: a number of 15 digits is kept, one of 16 digits sets nothing
set value: a decimal number keeps its digits
set value: a text question takes a formula's number as text
set value: a text question takes a yes or no as text
set value: a yes or no takes true, Yes, false and No
set value: a date must be a real calendar date
set value: a date question can be set to today
set value: a choice is set to one of its options only
set value: a formula that has no value removes the given answer and locks the question
set value: a set value is stored even while the question is hidden by logic
order: a set value that reads a set value that comes later in the form
order: set values that read each other in a circle have no value, as a calculation in a circle has none
order: text questions that set each other in a circle have no value
order: a calculation that reads a set value, and a trigger that reads the calculation
trigger: a rule that reads its own question is not active
trigger: a rule that reads an unknown question or variable is not active
trigger: a condition on an internal question is not active, as respondents are not served it
trigger: a formula that reads a heading, paragraph, divider or markdown block is not active (content holds no answer)
hidden fields: a declared name is known even when the link gave no value
hidden fields: a declared name with a value is read
hidden fields: a name the form does not declare is unknown
trigger: a formula is active when its value is truthy (text, numbers, lists)
trigger: an OR of conditions and an AND of conditions
group: a rule reads its own item and each item is decided on its own
group: a formula reads a sibling by its id
group: a rule reads a question of the page
group: only the items the respondent sees are decided (at most the maximum)
group: a page question reads the number of items
group: a formula reads a question across the items as a list
no rules: nothing is decided and nothing is removed
